Sweetness is the range of the wines the grape makes: dry, medium (off-dry) or sweet, or a range such as dry-sweet. Origins too (20 October 2026): the country a grape comes from, read by hand only from a sentence that says so plainly — its name, its adjective or a region wholly within it — and never where the articles disagree or hedge.
